description: She wears a navy floor-length overdress with low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow sleeves, over an ivory underdress visible in the central lower panel. Round shoulder brooches, tan-gold woven borders and a woven waist sash with hanging fringed ends decorate it. A grey-blue wrap with restrained pale fur edging rests along her forearms; brown leather shoes are visible. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
